build_ht: release original (main): multi-condition joins use the regular HT
notes: The small workloads show a 2x PHJ gain, but the CLI timer resolution is 1 ms, so the small numbers are coarse.
At 3D 90^3 (729k rows) the PHJ is slower (21 ms against 14 ms): the build overhead dominates.
The PHJ build is a per-row scalar mixed-radix fold over D key columns plus a Gather into the position table; the regular HT build is vectorized hashing.
The workload is a dense self join with count(*); the probe does not dominate, so the PHJ probe advantage does not offset the build cost at scale.
Follow-up: vectorize the mixed-radix fold (per-dimension offset computation is already vectorizable per column) and compare on probe-dominated workloads.
